## Context / Problem
Test assets outside `tests/unit/`, including interface, script, integration, external, and end-to-end suites. contains confirmed comment or docstring bloat from the audit pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192`. The file-specific constraints must survive consolidation.

## Approach
Delegate remediation to bounded directory/subsystem leaf cohorts. Each leaf edits only its declared paths, preserves the requirements recorded in its Scope, and supplies the authoritative file-impact set. This keeps responsibilities non-overlapping and each change reviewable in one session.

## Scope
- Direct container edits: none; repository edits belong to the leaf cohorts.
- Delegated repository area: Test assets outside `tests/unit/`, including interface, script, integration, external, and end-to-end suites.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every migrated path in this workstream appears in exactly one leaf Scope and matching file-impact record; verified by the migration inventory.
- [ ] Each path's comments or docstrings retain its listed current constraints and consumer contract while removing redundant text; verified by the leaf's row-by-row completion comment.
- [ ] Each leaf's declared verification commands exit 0 before that leaf closes.

## Child decomposition
Each directory/subsystem cohort owns all three criteria for its exact path set. Cohort path sets are disjoint; their union is this workstream's scope.
